scope: method research and next-step design; no implementation or performance result
verified_methods: Propagate shape upper bounds before static memory planning
Use actual tensor liveness and alias/backing analysis, then reuse compatible nonoverlapping buffer slices
Exclude caller-owned inputs and independent returned results from scratch reuse
Treat schedule, kernel workspace and borrowed history as a joint peak/copy cost rather than optimizing each arena count alone
relevance_to_current_code: plan_array_arena currently accumulates each original logical slot high-water capacity. V57D showed that deleting private capacity can regress HMM beta copying. Explore physical lifetime allocation with explicit loaned-history costs after V57G is independently qualified.
decision: Reference public planning methods in the existing native planner; do not introduce a second graph runtime solely for this memory bottleneck.
important_boundary: Current repeated complete-chain benchmark is GMM only; public methods do not demonstrate a gain in this engine.
